verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents the private-networking half of the story. Each CKS cluster runs in its own private VPC, with InfiniBand networking between bare-metal nodes, and VPC networking can be managed through Terraform and API tokens. Nothing in the evidence shows how a developer exposes ports or publishes services (load balancers, ingress, public IPs) from their nodes. missing for 10: documented port exposure/public service endpoints (ingress or load balancer), details on configuring private connectivity between instances or clusters, hands-on corroboration.
